_readme: GAME CONTENT, DRAFT PENDING PRODUCER REVIEW (every Title and Text). The tutorial hints (docs/design/area-zero.md, 'Tutorial beats'): each shows once, over the screen its Trigger belongs to (map_open, encounter_open, battle_start, battle_crit, battle_status, results_open, pick_open, camp_open, story_done), when every Condition holds (region:{id}, node:{n} = the Hearthglen location in play, beasts:{n} = exactly n owned, pick:{step}, tutorial = Hearthglen not yet behind the player, seen:{hintId}); ready hints of one trigger show one after another, higher Priority first. Dismissed hints are saved (PlayerSave.Tutorial.SeenHintIds) and never shown again; the settings' 'Tutorial hints' switch turns them all off. Anchor: the widget id the card points at on that screen, or top, center, bottom. Validated by BeastCraft.Tutorial.HintValidator (content load and the EditMode tests). Tone: content-bible.md (wonder first; nobody dies: defeated, knocked out, gloamed).

Hints.Title: Hearthglen
Hints.Text: This is your home vale. The glowing place is where you can go next: tap it to see what waits there.

Hints.Title: Scout for free
Hints.Text: Before every fight you see exactly who you will face: their kind, element and level, and the ground you will fight on.

Hints.Title: Your party
Hints.Text: Tap a beast to bring it. Vanguards hold the front, Ranged beasts strike from the back, Skirmishers dart round the side.

Hints.Title: Skills
Hints.Text: Your beasts pick their own skills. Each one rests for a few turns after use. Tap a skill below to read it.

Hints.Title: Your binder arts
Hints.Text: You never strike. From behind the line your arts mend, shield and rally your team. Your badge sits at the foot of the board.

Hints.Title: Elements
Hints.Text: One stingling hums with Nature. Fire burns Nature and Nature drinks Water: every element is strong against some and weak to others.

Hints.Title: Turn order
Hints.Text: The bar at the top shows who acts next. Quick creatures act more often.

Hints.Title: Critical hit!
Hints.Text: Big numbers are critical hits: lucky blows that land extra hard.

Hints.Title: Statuses
Hints.Text: The little icons under a health bar are statuses, like a burn, a shield or a stun. They wear off after a few turns.

Hints.Title: Rocks and logs
Hints.Text: From here on the ground is rougher. Nobody can stand on a rock or a stump, but skills fly right over them.

Hints.Title: A kinship stone
Hints.Text: Win this trial and a new beast will choose to join you: one of the next stance, so your team grows well rounded.

Hints.Title: The next stance
Hints.Text: Your team grows one stance at a time: Vanguard, then Ranged, then Skirmisher. Some pairs share a Team Bond.

Hints.Title: Bring a draught
Hints.Text: The Keeper's Fury Draughts make your team hit harder for a few turns. Pick one below before a tough fight.

Hints.Title: A full team
Hints.Text: One beast of each stance: from now on your team shares the Combined Arms bond in every fight.

Hints.Title: After the fight
Hints.Text: Every win pays XP, gold and materials. Fill the bar and your beast grows a level.

Hints.Title: Camp
Hints.Text: Resting at camp trains one beast. Here the Keeper also brings your newer beasts up to your strongest one's level.

Hints.Title: While you are away
Hints.Text: Your team keeps exploring when you rest. Tap the hourglass chip to collect what they found.

Hints.Title: The Gloam
Hints.Text: Something big and gloamed waits at the hedge. It is not wicked, only lost. Win, and the haze lets it go.
